meta.title: Add fast-path optimizations for Char.IsDigit in performance-critical paths
meta.body_summary: Add optimized call sites for Char.IsDigit property functions in MSBuild WellKnownFunctions to bypass reflection, with support for both single-character and string+index overloads, after initial attempt at ASCII range check was rescoped per maintainer feedback.

perf_labels.notes: Initial approach of ASCII range check across multiple files misaligned with issue; baronfel redirected to WellKnownFunctions bypass; after multiple refinements (use char.IsDigit, add overload, dedup, Theory tests) merged.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 224 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. It fits a targeted performance optimization PR with iterative review scope refinement, consistent with a successful merge.

review_details.concern_detail: Initial implementation added ASCII range checks in multiple files (CharacterUtilities, Scanner) rather than bypassing reflection for property function calls; baronfel explicitly instructed to revert and apply feedback focusing only on WellKnownFunctions.cs.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce overhead of evaluating $([System.Char]::IsDigit(...)) in MSBuild conditions by avoiding reflection-based invocation.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot interpreted performance issue as low-level ASCII digit micro-optimization across multiple files; maintainer corrected scope to specific well-known function bypass with single-file change, demonstrating that Agent required explicit direction for correct architectural fix in a complex build system.

detection_detail.code_reading: baronfel identified that the optimization should target WellKnownFunctions.cs to avoid reflection, not modify general character utilities.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests added to verify both overloads, but no before/after timing comparison. CI firewall issues prevented local test execution.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was reverted and re-scoped per feedback; final version passed test review with multiple approvals.

core_change_summary.description: Added fast-path handling for Char.IsDigit and Char.IsDigit(String, Int32) property function calls in WellKnownFunctions.cs to bypass reflection, replacing earlier scattered ASCII digit micro-optimizations.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Initial commits added fast ASCII digit checks in CharacterUtilities and Scanner, which were reverted after scope feedback.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and commit: Added CharacterUtilities.IsDigit ASCII check and replaced char.IsDigit in Scanner and CharacterUtilities.
KalleOlaviNiemitalo flagged misalignment with issue: should optimize property function calls, not general digit handling.
baronfel instructed Copilot to revert and apply feedback, restricting changes to WellKnownFunctions.cs.
Copilot reverted previous changes and added fast-path for Char.IsDigit property function calls in WellKnownFunctions.
baronfel inline review: use char.IsDigit rather than manual ASCII range check.
baronfel request: add support for Char.IsDigit(String, Int32) overload.
rainersigwald request: rewrite test as data-driven Theory using TestPropertyFunction.
All review feedback addressed; three approvals, merged.
